assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 16-bit pixel-art beat-em-up background atlas for Urban Fracture, detailed crisp pixel illustration, side view, no perspective distortion. Wide 3:1 image, TWO EQUAL horizontal panels spanning full width, each panel a unique continuous big-box store scene. TOP: entrance of a dilapidated abandoned discount superstore like a generic Walmart, seen from INSIDE along the front concourse. Sliding glass entrance at far left, rusted shopping cart corral, broken vending machines and TWO closed old fast food restaurant fronts with faded menu boards and empty seating entirely behind the combat lane, battered checkout lanes toward right. BOTTOM: deep store departments moving from shabby clothing racks and shoes on left to battered electronics and housewares in middle, to empty grocery shelves, overturned signs, gardening and hardware on right. Overhead aisle/department placards, no trademarks. Decayed tile and ceiling, dead fluorescent strips with a few dim lights. Red smoky sky visible through entrance glass, somber abandoned slums atmosphere. Each panel has clear walkable flat tile floor in bottom 25%, rear floor contact line at 75% panel height; background props behind that line. No people, no player, no enemies, no cars, no fire or smoke effects, no interface or GO signals. High detail, grounded realistic architecture, muted gray olive and rust, sharp edges, NOT blurry. Render 3072x1024 if possible.
